day13.description: Differentiable Architecture Search (DARTS) and continuous relaxation.

ground_truth.key_concept: DARTS transforms the discrete search space of candidate operations into a continuous space by placing a softmax distribution over all possible operations.
ground_truth.benefits: Enables joint optimization of weights and architecture via standard gradient descent.
ground_truth.drawbacks: High memory consumption during search, potential performance collapse due to skip-connection dominance.

dpp_questions.text: In the context of differentiable Neural Architecture Search (e.g., DARTS), how does the continuous relaxation of the architecture representation resolve the non-differentiability of the discrete search space?
options: (A) By applying REINFORCE to estimate the gradients.
(B) By replacing discrete categorical choices with a softmax over all possible operations.

day14.description: Core mechanics of the self-attention mechanism in Transformers.

ground_truth.scaling_factor: The dot products grow large in magnitude for large d_k, pushing the softmax function into regions where it has extremely small gradients. Scaling by sqrt(d_k) counteracts this effect.

dpp_questions.text: Why do we scale the dot product of Queries and Keys by the square root of the key dimension in Transformer attention?
options: (B) To prevent the dot products from growing too large and pushing the softmax into regions with vanishing gradients.
(C) To normalize the length of the value vectors.
(D) To enforce sparsity in the attention weights.
